title: auricula-ursi integrifolia
intro: Auricula-ursi integrifolia, commonly known as Bearberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to Europe, North America, and Asia. It has been used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include treating urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and inflammation due to its ability to increase urine production and reduce acidity in the body. The therapeutic actions of Bearberry are attributed to its astringent, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe and protect the mucous membranes and tissues. The bioactive constituents of Bearberry include arbutin, which is a key compound responsible for its medicinal properties, along with other flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
